name: gabriel-portfolio-frontend
description: Front-end bundles for the static site (Three.js + GSAP).

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('site/assets/js',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild hero=frontend/hero/main.js hub-industrial=frontend/hubs/industrial.js hub-automotivo=frontend/hubs/automotivo.js hub-f1=frontend/hubs/f1.js hub-porsche=frontend/hubs/porsche.js hub-lab=frontend/hubs/lab.js hub-sobre=frontend/hubs/sobre.js lapsim=frontend/lapsim/main.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=external --outdir=site/assets/js --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash]
